description: The bar chart visually compares the sentiment analysis accuracy of three tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two tweet categories: “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets,” with the latter also implicitly including tweets with emojis as noted in the x-axis label “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, using a linear scale to quantify performance. In the “Emoji Tweets” group, TEXTBLOB (white bar) achieves approximately 0.4 accuracy, VADER (diagonally striped bar) reaches just above 0.5, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) significantly outperforms both at approximately 0.7. In the “Overall Tweet” group, TEXTBLOB and VADER show comparable performance near 0.5, while ChatGPT again leads with an accuracy approaching 0.7. The legend in the lower right corner clearly maps the visual encoding: white for TEXTBLOB, diagonal hatching for VADER, and solid green for ChatGPT. All bars are grouped by category on the horizontal axis, with no sorting applied within groups, and ChatGPT’s consistent superiority is visually emphasized by its taller, uniformly green bars across both categories.
caption_used: The bar chart compares the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—across two categories of tweets: Emoji Tweets and Overall Tweets. The horizontal axis is divided into 'Emoji Tweets' and 'Overall Tweets,' with a sub-category labeled 'Overall Tweets and Tweets containing emojis.' The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with intervals marked at 0.2. For Emoji Tweets, TEXTBLOB achieves an accuracy of approximately 0.4, VADER slightly exceeds 0.5, and ChatGPT consistently surpasses 0.7. In the Overall Tweet category, TEXTBLOB and VADER show similar performance, both stabilizing around 0.5, while ChatGPT demonstrates a significant lead, reaching nearly 0.7. The legend, located in the bottom right corner, identifies the tools by their respective visual styles: white fill for TEXTBLOB, diagonal stripes for VADER, and green for ChatGPT.
